paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2018 - Internet of Things Meets Brain-Computer Interface A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Enabling Hu
title: Internet of Things Meets Brain-Computer Interface: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Enabling Human-Thing Cognitive Interactivity
motivation: BCI-based IoT control受限于低信噪比，且特征工程耗时且依赖领域专家知识
problem_framing: 从原始脑电信号中准确识别用户意图，转化为IoT设备可执行的命令
key_insight: 样本自相似性高于互相似性，即intra-intent内聚力强于inter-intent；利用强化学习自动搜索最具区分性的特征片段
method_signature: RS特征变换 + Dueling DQN选择性注意力机制(SAM) + WAS-LSTM跨维依赖分类
evaluation_criteria: 准确率/精确率/召回率/F1-score、延迟、混淆矩阵、ROC/AUC
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 仅7名受试者；SAM增加训练迭代时间；RS后最优顺序无法保证；需足够多的EEG通道数才能提供充分信息
evidence_for_taste: the eye-closed state is the easiest to be recognized
LSTM can remember longer sequences than GRU
the optimal order can not be guaranteed to appear after the RS
the accuracy has an approximately linear relationship with the reward
thinking_moves: 将脑电信号重新frame为communication问题而非仅perception
利用强化学习自动搜索最优特征子集，避免人工特征工程
将时序依赖改为空间跨维依赖(WAS-LSTM)
用轻量奖励模型G近似替代耗时的分类奖励F，节省98.3%训练时间
通过复制和随机打乱突破EEG通道固定顺序对维度依赖分析的限制
cites_own_work: Converting your thoughts to texts: Enabling brain typing via deep feature learning of EEG signals (PerCom 2018)
Intent recognition in smart living through deep recurrent neural networks (ICONIP 2017)
MindID: Person identification from brain waves through attention-based recurrent neural network (UbiComp 2018)
